Mission West offers impressive hillside living with panoramic views, newer homes, and the elevated lifestyle both literally and figuratively in this Fraser Valley community. This developing area attracts buyers seeking modern construction, stunning vistas of the Fraser Valley and surrounding mountains, plus the outdoor recreation access that defines Mission.

Properties feature contemporary designs on sloped lots taking advantage of views, many with walk-out basements and outdoor living spaces capturing the scenery. Residents appreciate the peaceful hillside setting while remaining close to Mission's downtown amenities, schools, and services via convenient road access. The area's elevation provides unique weather patterns and dramatic sunset views over the valley below. Despite newer development, Mission West maintains connection to the community's outdoor lifestyle with hiking and nature activities minutes away. Properties offer exceptional value for view homes compared to similar settings in Metro Vancouver. Ready to explore Mission West's hillside living?
